warmup: Separate 4-measured + 4-warmup batch before enabling profiler, then zero benchmark warmups inside profile window.
bound: torch profiler max_iterations=16; pinned wrapper stops when count >16 (up to 17 worker steps). Frontend CPU trace spans HTTP start/stop including benchmark client setup; exclude it from performance claims.
purpose: Verify CPU/CUDA event visibility, execution and launch/transfer patterns, not another throughput comparison.
retry_policy: No CUDA stack installation or profiler retry matrix.
